control_binding.reason: The product root is selected by CURRENT-AUTHORITY on main. Binding to the exact authority-file blob avoids self-invalidating the delegation merely because the delegation file itself is committed, while still invalidating it whenever product-root authority or the central objective changes.

selection_policy.rule: When CURRENT-AUTHORITY selects a READY or ACTIVE SYSTEM_MASTER-owned central_next_objective, the MASTER_ROOT working session must reconcile this file before ending. Root-owned non-system headless portfolios share this lane; do not create one Second Shift lane per tool.
selection_policy.future_tool_rule: A new SYSTEM_MASTER-owned headless tool or capability portfolio inherits this lane automatically. A genuinely new first-class owner system requires an explicit topology/ownership decision and registry entry.

active_delegations.completion_delta: Advance the current product-root Document admission from recovered-but-not-GitHub-native CR001-R4 source custody to an exact GitHub-native immutable source subject: import the authoritative 225-file CR001-R4 source tree, verify exact tree identity/custody, bind the resulting exact Git SHA, run all dependency-valid portable/hosted qualification available without A-01/native evidence, preserve exact receipts, and prepare truthful R5 admission adjudication without transferring historical PASS to the new subject.
active_delegations.stop_condition: The 225-file CR001-R4 source is durably present in GitHub-native custody with identity verification and an exact subject SHA, all currently executable portable/hosted qualification is recorded against that exact subject, and the next admission disposition is durably bound; or a concrete authority/dependency blocker is recorded and the highest-value independent SYSTEM_MASTER-owned successor is selected. Do not infer A-01/native/production PASS.
allowed_work: re-read CURRENT-AUTHORITY, current Document admission, source-custody manifest and authority-selected obligation registry
verify the authoritative CR001-R4 225-file source set and import it into GitHub-native immutable custody
verify exact source/tree identity and bind the resulting Git subject SHA
run deterministic portable and hosted qualification that is valid without A-01 or native Apple evidence
record exact receipts/evidence and prepare the truthful R5 admission adjudication
after completion or material block, re-read product-root authority and bind the next dependency-valid SYSTEM_MASTER-owned headless-tool successor while shift time remains
forbidden_authority: do not treat historical CR001-R4 PASS as PASS for a new Git SHA
do not fabricate or infer A-01, native Apple, publication, production or promotion authority
do not create a DOCUMENT first-class system or a per-tool owner lane; Documents remains a SYSTEM_MASTER-owned headless capability portfolio
do not mutate BOOK or PROSE canonical state while performing product-root Document work
do not bypass source-custody, exact-subject, owner or evidence boundaries
active_delegations.on_pass: Preserve exact Git source identity and qualification evidence, update current Document admission/obligation/completion authority through the normal product-root writer path, retire this delegation, then re-read CURRENT-AUTHORITY and bind the next SYSTEM_MASTER-owned central/root objective if unattended-safe work remains.
active_delegations.on_failure: Preserve the exact source/subject and failure classification. Repair only deterministic SYSTEM_MASTER-owned source/import/qualification defects. Route A-01/native/external/human authority dependencies truthfully and select independent safe root-owned work when available.
active_delegations.continuation_rule: Completion is not shift termination. Reconcile the product-root central objective and continue with the next dependency-valid unattended-safe SYSTEM_MASTER-owned headless capability task while capacity remains.
